scope: canonical flat RLL logistic background, local CPL tangent coordinates at a=1
assumptions: flat-background closure is applied consistently when Omega_Lambda is derived

exact_results.sign_theorem: Under the assumptions, total_dark_wa >= 0; it is exactly 0 when Omega_s0=0 and strictly >0 for Omega_s0>0 with nonzero finite factors.

corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.incorrect: w0=-f0 is the full RLL dark-sector coordinate
corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.correct: w0=-f0 is the isolated superposition-sector coordinate; the canonical total dark-sector coordinate includes Omega_Lambda.
Negative wa values are posterior/best-fit results within specified model+dataset combinations; they are not direct observables and are dataset-dependent.

corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.incorrect: A model whose prediction disagrees with data fails falsifiability.
corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.correct: A risky sign prediction is evidence of falsifiability; sufficiently robust exclusion can falsify that model form in a stated data/assumption scope.

corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.incorrect: A non-OSI custom license makes scientific falsifiability empty.
corrections_to_pasted_interpretation.correct: License interoperability and scientific falsifiability are separate gates. A custom license can impede code reuse, but does not by itself erase mathematical testability.

observational_gate.reason: The canonical RLL local tangent domain has wa_eff>=0 while several external CPL fits have negative-wa central/posterior support. A matched posterior-overlap calculation is still required before declaring the canonical RLL form falsified.
required_next_test: materialize a public DESI posterior/chain for a precisely named dataset combination
coarse pre-gate: compute posterior mass P(wa>=0 | D) with the same CPL convention
decisive gate: compute 2D posterior overlap/HPD distance with the full RLL-accessible local (w0_eff,wa_eff) domain under current parameter bounds
repeat with/without SN and with the 2026 Ly-alpha full-shape update
report prior sensitivity and the local-coordinate-versus-global-likelihood limitation
observational_gate.falsification_condition: Only declare FALSIFIED_IN_SCOPE if a predeclared, likelihood-matched posterior excludes the full RLL-accessible 2D local prediction domain (not merely wa>=0) at the chosen confidence/evidence threshold and the local mapping is validated against global observables.
